fullContentHtml:
BELTRON DEO Provisional Merit List 2026 – Full Details

Bihar State Electronics Development Corporation Limited (BSEDC) has released the provisional merit list for the Data Entry Operator (DEO) Post. The applications for BELTRON DEO Recruitment 2024 were accepted from 20 February 2024 to 15 March 2024. The DV was held on 28 April 2025 to 04 May 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their BELTRON DEO Provisional Merit List 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 February 2024
  • Last Date : 15 March 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 March 2024
  • New Exam Date : 27 January 2025
  • Admit Card : 21 January 2025
  • Answer Key : 31 January 2025
  • Result Release Date : 17 March 2025
  • DV Date : 28 April to 04 May 2025
  • Provisional Merit List : 29 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs 1000/-
  • SC, ST of Bihar : Rs 250/-
  • All Female Category of Bihar : Rs 250/-
  • PH (40%) Candidates : Rs 250/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

BELTRON DEO Provisional Merit List 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
